subject: Deferred lifecycle reconciliation for Node 26 and pnpm migration waves
project_scope: domainspec-core parent repository plus implementation/domainspec and validation/poker-team private submodules
why_now: The user directly authorized local implementation of the Node 26.8.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, and pnpm 10.34.5 migration waves while explicitly deferring governance and lifecycle bookkeeping.
key_points: The active implementation target is one containerized Node and TypeScript toolchain, one pnpm dependency authority per Git repository boundary, and no active checkout-local node_modules after package-level validation.
The parent repository is migrated in bounded waves before the two private DomainSpec-owned submodules are migrated independently.
This notice records deferred reconciliation only; implementation progress and validation results must be established from fresh repository evidence.
Public Arcanum, collaborator-owned submodules, historical or staged evidence, publication, deployment, commits, pushes, and gitlink advancement are outside this notice's implementation authority.

open_calls.question: Reconcile completed migration-wave bytes and validation evidence into the repository lifecycle after the candidate-local implementation ends.
Authorize any later commit, publication, submodule commit, or parent gitlink advancement separately after exact-byte review.

boundaries: Communication evidence only; this notice and its locator grant no permission, selection, admission, execution, commit, publication, deployment, or external-effect authority.
Do not alter public Arcanum or copy private DomainSpec material into it.
Do not treat historical, staged, generated, or fixture package roots as active migration targets without separate evidence and authorization.
Preserve unrelated dirty bytes and collaborator-owned submodules; use exact path allowlists for any later reconciliation.
Validate and reconcile implementation/domainspec and validation/poker-team inside their own repository boundaries before considering a parent gitlink update.

next_actions.action: Execute the approved waves locally, preserving per-wave audit, typecheck, build, test, and browser evidence without publication or deployment.
After implementation ends, inventory exact changed bytes and validation receipts, classify incomplete waves and blockers, and prepare a bounded reconciliation candidate.
Review and separately decide any adoption, commit, submodule publication, or gitlink advancement request.
